title: Home guide: food colouring in cold and warm water
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 30 (Home practical guide and safety card: food colouring diffusion (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, adult pours))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how temperature affects the speed of diffusion.
safety: Warm tap water only; an adult pours it
Work on a tray; food colouring stains
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Pour the same amount of cold water into one cup; an adult pours warm tap water into the other.
Add one drop of food colouring to each at the same time.
Time how long until the colour has spread through each cup.
